alerts.headline: Child Abduction Emergency issued September 6 at 2:02PM CDT by NWS Nashville TN
alerts.description: CAETN The following message is transmitted at the request of the Tennessee Bureau of Investigation. An Amber Alert has been issued on behalf of the Greene County Sheriff's Department for Atreus Johann Bird. Atreus is a 2 year old male, 3 feet tall, 30 pounds, with blonde hair and blue eyes. Atreus was last seen today in the area of Hilldale Road in Midway, TN. Atreus was last seen wearing a diaper and blue Olaf pajama bottoms with no shirt and no shoes. Atreus has a known medical condition that may impair his ability to return safely without assistance. If you have seen Atreus or have information regarding his whereabouts, please contact the Greene County Sheriff's Department at 4 2 3 7 9 8 1 8 0 0 or the T B I at 1- 8 0 0 T B I F I N D.
